text: dsh-folder-attach 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的文件夹输入插件，在会话输入框旁提供添加文件夹按钮，并注册 /folder 命令。用户可通过宿主机目录选择器选取文件夹，将路径作为标准 @路径引用插入草稿；也可拖入或粘贴文件夹，插件按名称查询工作区索引并插入匹配路径。混合拖放中的普通文件仍交给原有附件流程处理。它适合希望在浏览器版 DSH 中引用本机文件夹的开发者。实现使用公开的 composer 槽位、命令界面和远程目录/文件引用接口。

dsh-folder-attach adds a folder button and /folder command to the DSH web composer. Users can choose a host folder and insert its path as an @reference, or drag and paste folders for name-based lookup in the current workspace. Other files in a mixed drop continue through the regular attachment flow.
想在 DSH 网页版输入框里插入一个本机文件夹路径。
能不能把文件夹拖进网页会话，让它变成 @路径引用？
How can I choose a local folder from the DSH browser composer and insert its path?
dsh-folder-attach 的功能「选择主机文件夹」：点击输入框旁的添加文件夹按钮或运行 /folder，打开宿主目录选择器，并将所选路径插入当前草稿。
dsh-folder-attach 的功能「拖放文件夹引用」：拖入或粘贴文件夹后，按名称在当前工作区索引中解析路径并插入 @引用；同批普通文件继续走原附件上传流程。

dsh-folder-attach README · dsh-folder-attach：[](https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[](LICENSE)

DSH 网页版拖入文件夹会被拒绝：「只有桌面端支持添加文件夹，浏览器里请添加单个文件」。
这个插件让它在**纯浏览器**里可用 —— 拖文件夹、`/folder`、主机文件夹选择框，都插入标准 `@路径` 引用。

> [English](README.en.md) · 需要 dsh `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`

dsh-folder-attach README · 原理：Web 界面分两半：浏览器里的 client，和你机器上的 Node host。浏览器是沙箱化的，**host 不是**。

DSH 已经自带一个宿主目录选择能力（`dsh-host-directory-picker-auto`）。在 macOS + 回环绑定时它解析成 `native` 后端，在**宿主机**上执行：

```
osascript -e 'choose folder' -e 'POSIX path of selectedFolder'
```

返回一个真实的绝对路径。插件把它接到输入框上——桌面端那条判定根本不会被触发。

拖入的文件夹则用 `fileReferences/list`（`@` 补全菜单背后的同一个索引）按名称解析：一次调用，宿主自己的模糊索引，已排除 `node_modules` 等。

dsh-folder-attach README · 功能：| 入口 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 输入框左侧「添加文件夹」 | 在宿主机弹出系统文件夹对话框，选中后插入 `@目录/` |
| `/folder` 命令 | 同上 |
| 拖入 / 粘贴文件夹 | 按名称在工作区内解析，插入 `@目录/`；同批普通文件走原有上传通道 |

插入的是**标准 `@路径` mention**，与桌面端拖文件夹产生的等价：工作区内用相对形式，工作区外保留绝对形式，含空格自动加引号。

dsh-folder-attach README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-folder-attach
```

也可以从 GitHub 装（同一份源码，可钉到某个 tag）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach
```

也可以在侧边栏 **插件 → 添加插件** 里填上面的地址。装完刷新浏览器页面。

<details>
<summary>从源码安装</summary>

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach.git
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web        # 或你的 profile 目录
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-folder-attach
```

</details>

dsh-folder-attach README · 卸载：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-folder-attach
```

或在插件页关闭开关。插件只在浏览器内注册一个 composer 槽位、一个斜杠命令和两个事件监听器，不写任何全局对象，卸载即无痕。

dsh-folder-attach README · 开发：```bash
npm test          # 两个回归测试
npm run check     # 语法检查 + 测试
```

无需构建：`dsh-client-modules` 把 `lib/client.js` **逐字节原样**作为浏览器 bundle 服务，所以它按 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 格式手写。

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 空的宿主侧 `apply`，让包成为 Loader 条目、从而被扫描到 |
| `lib/client.js` | 全部行为 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 该 bundle 启用时贡献的组合层 |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件页显示名（**`en.json` 必须存在**，否则 `zh.json` 不会被读取） |

dsh-folder-attach README · 依赖的公开接缝：只用官方声明过的扩展点，不改写官方代码、不打 monkeypatch：

- `ctx.slots.inject("conversation.input.left", …)` — 官方文档点名的 composer 扩展位
- 该座位的标准 props：`sessionId`、`inputActions`、`t`
- `ctx.commandUi.register({ name: "folder", ui: { kind: "action" } })`
- `ctx.remote.directoryPicker.pick()` — 宿主系统对话框，返回绝对路径
- `ctx.remote.fileReferences.list(sessionId, query)` — `@` 菜单背后的索引查询

dsh-folder-attach README · 已知限制：- **拖入/粘贴**的文件夹只能按名称在工作区内解析。浏览器不给路径，这无法回避；解析不到时明确报错并提示改用对话框，不会猜一个路径。
- 拖入产生的是 `@目录/` **纯文本 mention**，不是桌面端那种带图标的文件夹 chip——chip 需要真实路径。功能等价，外观不同。
- 索引查询有返回上限，极端情况下同名文件夹可能不在候选里，此时按未解析处理。
- 若 profile 把目录选择解析成 `browse` 后端（远程 / SSH 访问），系统对话框不可用，`pick` 会拒绝并提示；此时仍可用拖拽解析。
- 混合拖拽（文件夹 + 图片）时，插件会复刻 composer 的图片数量/体积预检，**但只统计本次拖入的图片**：已挂载的附件没有任何公开接口可读。宿主侧 `validateImageBatch` 仍按整条消息强制校验，所以这不是漏洞，只是提示可能来得更早、口径更宽。
- 插件页显示名依赖 `locale/en.json` 存在。
dsh-folder-attach README · 为什么它能活过 dsh 升级：兼容性闸门只校验 `peerDependencies` 里 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 前缀的版本，本插件不声明它，因此升级不会让 bundle 被跳过。真正的风险是上面那些接缝改名——那时表现是**静默不显示**，不会拖垮 DSH。
section: 为什么它能活过 dsh 升级

text:
dsh-folder-attach README · dsh-folder-attach：[](https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[](LICENSE)

Drag a folder into the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web composer and it refuses: "folders can only be added in the desktop app".
This plugin makes it work in a **plain browser** — folder drag, `/folder`, and a host folder dialog, all inserting standard `@path` references.

> [中文](README.md) · requires dsh `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`

dsh-folder-attach README · The problem：A browser never reveals the absolute path of a dropped folder, so only the desktop shell (Electron, which injects `__DSH_HOST_PATHS__`) can map a `File` back to a real path. And `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **ships no desktop app today**: `dsh web` accepts only `--host/--port/--no-open/--trusted-host`, and nothing in the published bundle ever writes that global.

This plugin doesn't work around that check. It **changes where the answer comes from**: ask the host, not the browser.

dsh-folder-attach README · How it works：The web GUI is two halves — a browser client and a Node host on your machine. The browser is sandboxed; **the host is not**.

DSH already ships a host-side directory chooser (`dsh-host-directory-picker-auto`). On macOS with a loopback bind it resolves to the `native` backend, which runs **on the host**:

```
osascript -e 'choose folder' -e 'POSIX path of selectedFolder'
```

That returns a real absolute path. The plugin wires it to the composer, so the desktop-only branch is never entered.

dsh-folder-attach README · How it works：Dropped folders are resolved by name through `fileReferences/list` — the same indexed fuzzy lookup that backs the `@` completion menu. One call, and the index already excludes `node_modules` and friends.

dsh-folder-attach README · Features：| Entry point | Behavior |
|---|---|
| "Add folder" button, left of the composer | Opens the OS folder dialog on the host, inserts `@dir/` |
| `/folder` command | Same |
| Drag / paste a folder | Resolves the name inside the workspace and inserts `@dir/`; non-folder members keep the normal upload path |

dsh-folder-attach README · Features：What gets inserted is a **standard `@path` mention**, equivalent to what the desktop app produces: workspace-relative inside the workspace, absolute outside it, quoted when the path contains whitespace.

dsh-folder-attach README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-folder-attach
```

Or pin it to a tag straight from GitHub (same source):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach#v0.1.4
```

You can also paste either form into **Plugins → Add** in the sidebar. Reload the browser page afterwards.

<details>
<summary>Install from source</summary>

dsh-folder-attach README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach.git
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web        # or your profile directory
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-folder-attach
```

</details>

dsh-folder-attach README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-folder-attach
```

Or flip the switch on the Plugins page. The plugin registers one composer slot, one slash command, and two event listeners — it writes no globals, so removal leaves nothing behind.

dsh-folder-attach README · Development：```bash
npm test          # both regression suites
npm run check     # syntax check + tests
```

There is no build step: `dsh-client-modules` serves `lib/client.js` to the browser **byte-for-byte verbatim**, so it is hand-written in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` format.

dsh-folder-attach README · Development：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Empty host `apply`, making the package a Loader entry so it gets scanned |
| `lib/client.js` | All behavior |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The composition layer contributed while the bundle is enabled |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | Plugin-page display name (**`en.json` must exist**, or `zh.json` is never read) |

dsh-folder-attach README · Public seams used：Only extension points the official docs declare — no patched or monkeypatched upstream code:

- `ctx.slots.inject("conversation.input.left", …)` — the documented composer slot
- Its standard props: `sessionId`, `inputActions`, `t`
- `ctx.commandUi.register({ name: "folder", ui: { kind: "action" } })`
- `ctx.remote.directoryPicker.pick()` — host OS dialog, returns an absolute path
- `ctx.remote.fileReferences.list(sessionId, query)` — the index behind the `@` menu

dsh-folder-attach README · Known limitations：- **Dropped/pasted** folders can only be resolved by name inside the workspace. The browser hides their paths and that is unavoidable; when a name cannot be located the plugin says so and points at the dialog rather than guessing a path.
- A drop yields a plain `@dir/` **text mention**, not the folder chip the desktop app renders — a chip needs a real path. Functionally equivalent, visually different.
- The indexed lookup is bounded, so in extreme cases a same-named folder may be absent from the candidates and is then treated as unresolved.
- If your profile resolves the directory picker to the `browse` backend (remote / SSH access), the OS dialog is unavailable and `pick` refuses with a message; drag resolution still works.
- On a mixed drop (folder + images) the plugin mirrors the composer's image count/size pre-check, but **counts only the images in that drop**: already-attached images are not readable through any public face. The Host's `validateImageBatch` still enforces the full per-message limit, so this is an earlier and looser notice, not a hole.
- Plugin-page display names require `locale/en.json` to be present.

dsh-folder-attach README · Why it survives dsh updates：The compatibility gate only checks `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` prefixes in `peerDependencies`, and this plugin declares none, so an update never causes the bundle to be skipped. The real risk is one of the seams above being renamed — in which case the plugin **fails silent** (it just doesn't appear) rather than breaking DSH.

- A drop yields a plain `@dir/` **text mention**, not the folder chip the desktop app renders — a chip needs a real path. Functionally equivalent, visually different.
- The indexed lookup is bounded, so in extreme cases a same-named folder may be absent from the candidates and is then treated as unresolved.
- If your profile resolves the directory picker to the `browse` backend (remote / SSH access), the OS dialog is unavailable and `pick` refuses with a message; drag resolution still works.
- On a mixed drop (folder + images) the plugin mirrors the composer's image count/size pre-check, but **counts only the images in that drop**: already-attached images are not readable through any public face. The Host's `validateImageBatch` still enforces the full per-message limit, so this is an earlier and looser notice, not a hole.
- Plugin-page display names require `locale/en.json` to be present.

dsh-folder-attach README · Why it survives dsh updates：The compatibility gate only checks `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` prefixes in `peerDependencies`, and this plugin declares none, so an update never causes the bundle to be skipped. The real risk is one of the seams above being renamed — in which case the plugin **fails silent** (it just doesn't appear) rather than breaking DSH.
